240: u8 cal_crc8_0x31(u8 *data_buf, u16 len)
241: {
242: 	u8    crc = 0x00;
243: 
244: 	for (u32 i = 0; i < len; i++)
245: 	{
246: 		crc = crc8_table[crc ^ data_buf[i]];
247: 	}
248: 
249: 	return (crc);
250: }

282: static mb_ipc_route_t * ipc_router_search_route(u8 dst_cpu, u32 * route_id)
283: {
284: 	mb_ipc_route_t  * ipc_route = NULL;
285: 
286: 	for(int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route_tbl); i++)
287: 	{
288: 		if(ipc_route_tbl[i].dst_cpus & (0x01 << dst_cpu))
289: 		{
290: 			ipc_route = &ipc_route_tbl[i];
291: 			*route_id = i;
292: 			break;
293: 		}
294: 	}
295: 
296: 	return ipc_route;
297: }
298: 
299: /*
300:  * because ipc_cmd is a pointer, 
301:  * it may pending in the tx_queue, 
302:  * so the memory ipc_cmd pointed must **NOT** be in stack (temporary memory).
303:  * 
304:  */
305: static int ipc_router_send(mb_ipc_route_t *ipc_route, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
306: {
307: 	int   queue_cnt; // number of items in the queue.
308: 	int   free_cnt;
309: 
310: 	/* used to protect ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx. */
311: 	u32 temp = mb_ipc_enter_critical();
312: 
313: 	if(ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx >= ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_out_idx)
314: 	{
315: 		queue_cnt = ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx - ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_out_idx;
316: 		free_cnt  = ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue) - queue_cnt;
317: 	}
318: 	else
319: 	{
320: 		free_cnt  = ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_out_idx - ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx;
321: 		queue_cnt = ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue) - free_cnt;
322: 	}
323: 	
324: 	if( free_cnt <= 1 )  // reserved one for empty judgement.
325: 	{
326: 		mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
327: 		
328: 		return  IPC_ROUTE_QUEUE_FULL;
329: 	}
330: 	
331: 	u16  tx_idx = ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx;
332: 	
333: 	// memcpy(&ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx], ipc_cmd, sizeof(mb_ipc_cmd_t));
334: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx].mb_cmd.hdr.data = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.hdr.data;
335: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx].mb_cmd.param1 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1;
336: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx].mb_cmd.param2 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2;
337: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx].mb_cmd.param3 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3;
338: 	
339: 	tx_idx = (tx_idx + 1) % ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue);
340: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx = tx_idx;
341: 
342: 	mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);  /* used to protect ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx. */
343: 
344: 	// it is the first item pushed to the queue, then try to send.
345: 	if(queue_cnt == 0)
346: 	{
347: 		mb_chnl_write(ipc_route->log_chnl, &ipc_cmd->mb_cmd);
348: 	}
349: 
350: 	return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;
351: }

353: /* 
354:  * it MUST be protected by critical-section.
355:  * it is called by RX-ISR.
356:  */
357: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
358: static int ipc_router_fwd(mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
359: {
360: 	u32               route_id;
361: 	mb_ipc_route_t  * ipc_route = ipc_router_search_route(ipc_cmd->dst_cpu, &route_id);
362: 
363: 	if(ipc_route == NULL)
364: 	{
365: 		// no route for this destination cpu.
366: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
367: 	}
368: 
369: 	// forward this cmd.
370: 	return ipc_router_send(ipc_route, ipc_cmd);
371: }
372: #endif

374: static void ipc_router_rx_isr(void *param, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
375: {
376: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t     * ipc_cmd = (mb_ipc_cmd_t *)cmd_buf;
377: 
378: 	#if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
379: 	/* please refer to <design document> P45 rx_isr 2). */
380: 	// if it is a fwd cmd/rsp.
381: 	if( ipc_cmd->dst_cpu != CURRENT_CPU )  // it is not for me, then forward it.
382: 	{
383: 		BK_ASSERT(CURRENT_CPU == MAILBOX_CPU1); // in current configuration, CPU1 used to forward cmd.
384: 
385: 		ipc_cmd->route_status = ipc_router_fwd(ipc_cmd);
386: 
387: 		return;
388: 	}
389: 	#endif
390: 
391: 	// it is for me, process the cmd/rsp.
392: 
393: 	// find the ipc_socket connection for the cmd/rsp.
394: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket;
395: 	ipc_socket = ipc_socket_search_recver(ipc_cmd->dst_port, ipc_cmd->src_cpu, ipc_cmd->src_port);
396: 
397: 	ipc_cmd->route_status = ipc_socket_rx_handler(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
398: 
399: 	#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
400: 	if(ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
401: 	{
402: 		// ipc_socket may be == NULL, don't reference it.
403: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "rx error: cmd-%02x, param1=%08x!\r\n", 
404: 			ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
405: 	}
406: 	#endif
407: 
408: 	return;
409: }

411: static void ipc_router_tx_cmpl_isr(void *param, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
412: {
413: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t     * ipc_cmd = (mb_ipc_cmd_t *)ack_buf;
414: 	u32                route_id = (u32)param;
415: 
416: 	// data sanity check.
417: 	if(route_id >= ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route_tbl))
418: 	{
419: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s error @%d, id=%d!\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, route_id);
420: 		return;   /* something wrong. */
421: 	}
422: 
423: 	// data sanity check.
424: 	if(ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_in_idx == ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_out_idx)
425: 	{
426: 		// queue empty.
427: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s error @%d, indx=%d!\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
428: 			ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_in_idx);
429: 		
430: 		return;   /* something wrong. */
431: 	}
432: 
433: 	u16  tx_idx = ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_out_idx;
434: 	
435: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t * queue_cmd = &ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx];
436: 
437: 	// data sanity check.
438: 	if( (((queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param1 ^ ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1) & IPC_PARAM1_MASK) != 0)
439: 		|| (queue_cmd->hdr.cmd != ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd)
440: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
441: 		|| (queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param2 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2)
442: 		|| (queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param3 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3) 
443: 		#endif
444: 		) /* param1, other fields not compared. */
445: 	{
446: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s tx2 error @%d! %x != %x.\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
447: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param1, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
448: 
449: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
450: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "tx2 error: ipc-cmd-%02x, %x != %x.\r\n", ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, 
451: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param2, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2);
452: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "tx2 error: que-cmd-%02x, %x != %x.\r\n", queue_cmd->hdr.cmd, 
453: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param3, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3);
454: 		#endif
455: 
456: 		return;   /* something wrong. */ /* not the CMD just sent. */
457: 	}
458: 
459: 	/* remove the first cmd from the queue. */
460: 	tx_idx = (tx_idx + 1) % ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue);
461: 	ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_out_idx = tx_idx;
462: 
463: 	#if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
464: 	// it is a forwarded cmd/rsp.
465: 	if( ipc_cmd->src_cpu != CURRENT_CPU )
466: 	{
467: 		if( (ipc_cmd->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) || 
468: 			(ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK) )
469: 		{
470: 			BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fwd failed, cmd %02x, param1=%08x!\r\n", 
471: 				ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
472: 		}
473: 
474: 		goto tx_cmpl_isr_next_cmd;
475: 	}
476: 	#endif
477: 
478: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket;
479: 	
480: 	// search the ipc_socket by port;
481: 	ipc_socket = ipc_socket_search_sender(ipc_cmd->src_port, ipc_cmd->dst_cpu, ipc_cmd->dst_port);
482: 
483: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
484: 	{
485: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s tx error @%d!, cmd-%02x, param1=%08x!\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
486: 			ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
487: 
488: 		goto tx_cmpl_isr_next_cmd;
489: 	}
490: 
491: 	ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_handler(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
492: 
493: tx_cmpl_isr_next_cmd:
494: 
495: 	/* refer to <design document> P45 tx_cmpl_isr 3). */
496: 
497: 	if(ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_in_idx == ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_out_idx)
498: 		return;  // no pending cmd in the queue.
499: 
500: 	queue_cmd = &ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx];
501: 
502: 	// send next pending cmd. // refer to <design document> P45 tx_cmpl_isr 3).
503: 	mb_chnl_write(ipc_route_tbl[route_id].log_chnl, &queue_cmd->mb_cmd);
504: 
505: 	return;
506: 
507: }

699: static int ipc_socket_local_tx_cmd(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd);
700: static int ipc_socket_local_tx_rsp(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd);
701: 
702: /*
703:  * because ipc_cmd is a pointer, 
704:  * it may pending in the tx_queue, 
705:  * so the memory ipc_cmd pointed must **NOT** be in stack (temporary memory).
706:  * 
707:  */
708: static int ipc_socket_tx_rsp(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
709: {
710: 	if(ipc_socket->dst_cpu == ipc_socket->src_cpu)
711: 	{
712: 		return ipc_socket_local_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
713: 	}
714: 	
715: 	u32               temp;
716: 	mb_ipc_route_t  * ipc_route = ipc_router_search_route(ipc_socket->dst_cpu, &temp);
717: 
718: 	if(ipc_route == NULL)
719: 	{
720: 		// no route for this destination cpu.
721: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
722: 	}
723: 
724: 	ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd |= MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG;   // set to rsp packet.
725: 	
726: 	ipc_socket_set_addr(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
727: 
728: 	uint32_t flags = rtos_disable_int();
729: 	
730: 	int route_status = ipc_router_send(ipc_route, ipc_cmd);
731: 
732: 	if(route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
733: 	{
734: 		ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear rx_in_process.
735: 	}
736: 
737: 	rtos_enable_int(flags);
738: 
739: 	return route_status;
740: }
741: 
742: /*
743:  * because ipc_cmd is a pointer, 
744:  * it may pending in the tx_queue, 
745:  * so the memory ipc_cmd pointed must **NOT** be in stack (temporary memory).
746:  * 
747:  */
748: static int ipc_socket_tx_cmd(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd, u32 retry)
749: {
750: 	if(retry == 0)
751: 	{
752: 		ipc_socket->tx_tag++;
753: 	}
754: 	ipc_cmd->tag = ipc_socket->tx_tag;
755: 	
756: 	if(ipc_socket->dst_cpu == ipc_socket->src_cpu)
757: 	{
758: 		return ipc_socket_local_tx_cmd(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
759: 	}
760: 	
761: 	u32               temp;
762: 	mb_ipc_route_t  * ipc_route = ipc_router_search_route(ipc_socket->dst_cpu, &temp);
763: 
764: 	if(ipc_route == NULL)
765: 	{
766: 		// no route for this destination cpu.
767: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
768: 	}
769: 
770: 	ipc_socket_set_addr(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
771: 
772: 	uint32_t flags = rtos_disable_int();
773: 	
774: 	int route_status = ipc_router_send(ipc_route, ipc_cmd);
775: 
776: 	if(route_status == IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
777: 	{
778: 		ipc_socket->run_state |= STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;
779: 	}
780: 
781: 	rtos_enable_int(flags);
782: 
783: 	return route_status;
784: }

799: static void ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_notify(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket)
800: {
801: 	ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear tx_in_process.
802: 
803: 	/* tx_complete notification. */

807: static void ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_handler(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t * ipc_cmd)
808: {
809: 	// if it is a rsp.
810: 	/* refer to <design document> P44 tx_cmpl_isr 1). */
811: 	if( ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd & MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG )
812: 	{
813: 		if( (ipc_cmd->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) || 
814: 			(ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK) )
815: 		{
816: 			BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Rsp failed, cmd %02x, param1=%08x!\r\n", 
817: 				ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
818: 		}
819: 
820: 		// completed the rx-process, so clear the flag.
821: 		ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear rx_in_process.
822: 
823: 		if(ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd == (MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG | MB_IPC_DISCONNECT_CMD)) // disconnect rsp send ok.
824: 		{
825: 			ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = 0;
826: 			ipc_socket->dst_port = 0;  // clear the connection.
827: 		}
828: 		
829: 		return;
830: 	}
831: 
832: 	// it is a cmd.
833: 
834: 	// queue_cmd points to the tx_cmd, ipc_cmd must match the current state of tx_cmd.
835: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t * queue_cmd = &ipc_socket->tx_cmd;
836: 
837: 	// data sanity check.
838: 	if( (((queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param1 ^ ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1) & IPC_PARAM1_MASK) != 0)
839: 		|| (queue_cmd->hdr.cmd != ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd)
840: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
841: 		|| (queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param2 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2)
842: 		|| (queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param3 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3) 
843: 		#endif
844: 		) /* param1, other fields not compared. */
845: 	{
846: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s tx2 error @%d! %x != %x.\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
847: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param1, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
848: 
849: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
850: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "tx2 error: ipc-cmd-%02x, %x != %x.\r\n", ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, 
851: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param2, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2);
852: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "tx2 error: que-cmd-%02x, %x != %x.\r\n", queue_cmd->hdr.cmd, 
853: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param3, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3);
854: 		#endif
855: 
856: 		return;   /* something wrong. */ /* not the CMD just sent. */
857: 	}
858: 	
859: 	// if send failed.
860: 	/* refer to <design document> P44 tx_cmpl_isr 2). */
861: 	if( (ipc_cmd->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) || 
862: 		(ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK) )
863: 	{
864: 
865: 		if(ipc_cmd->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
866: 		{
867: 			// mailbox channel tx failed. 
868: 			ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_TX_FAILED;
869: 		}
870: 		else  // (ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
871: 		{
872: 			// router failed.
873: 			ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_ROUTE_BASE_FAILED + ipc_cmd->route_status;
874: 		}
875: 
876: 		ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_notify(ipc_socket);
877: 
878: 		return;
879: 	}
880: 
881: }

883: static int ipc_socket_rx_rsp_handler(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
884: {
885: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
886: 	{
887: 		// no connection for this rsp.
888: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
889: 	}
890: 
891: 	if( (ipc_socket->run_state & STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS) == 0 )	/* unsolicited ipc response. */
892: 	{
893: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNSOLICITED_RSP;
894: 	}
895: 
896: 	if(ipc_socket->tx_tag != ipc_cmd->tag)
897: 	{
898: 		/* un-matched response. */
899: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNMATCHED_RSP;
900: 	}
901: 
902: 	if(ipc_socket->tx_cmd.hdr.cmd != (ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd & MB_IPC_CMD_MASK))
903: 	{
904: 		/* un-matched response. */
905: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNMATCHED_RSP;
906: 	}
907: 
908: 	// data sanity check.
909: 	if( (ipc_socket->tx_cmd.tag != ipc_cmd->tag)
910: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
911: 		|| (ipc_socket->tx_cmd.mb_cmd.param2 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2)
912: 		|| (ipc_socket->tx_cmd.mb_cmd.param3 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3) 
913: 		#endif
914: 		) /* param1, other fields not compared. */
915: 	{
916: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
917: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s error @%d, %d != %d.\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
918: 			ipc_socket->tx_cmd.tag, ipc_cmd->tag);
919: 		#endif
920: 
921: 		/* not the response for the CMD just sent. */
922: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNMATCHED_RSP;
923: 	}
924: 
925: 	#if 0   // can't clear connection here, becasue tx_cmpl_isr will use this connection again.
926: 	        // if there is direct connection between 2 cores, rsp will arrive ahead of cmd-tx_cmpl_isr.
927: 	if(ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd == (MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG | MB_IPC_DISCONNECT_CMD)) // disconnected.
928: 	{
929: 		// it must have been disconnected in the peer side.
930: 		ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = 0;
931: 		ipc_socket->dst_port = 0;  // clear the connection.
932: 	}
933: 	#endif
934: 
935: 	/* save cmd return-status, tx is completed. */
936: 	if(ipc_cmd->api_impl_status != IPC_API_IMPL_STATUS_OK)
937: 		ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_API_BASE_FAILED + ipc_cmd->api_impl_status;
938: 	else
939: 		ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_TX_OK;
940: 
941: 	ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_notify(ipc_socket);
942: 
943: 	return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;  // this status return is worthless but for debug.
944: }

946: static void ipc_socket_rx_cmd_error_handler(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, int error_code)
947: {
948: 	ipc_socket->rx_cmd.api_impl_status = error_code & 0x0F;
949: 
950: 	ipc_socket_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->rx_cmd);
951: }

953: // connect command handler, it is handled internally.
954: static int ipc_socket_rx_cmd_connect(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket)
955: {
956: 	ipc_socket->use_flag  |= USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
957: 	ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;  // must have no cmd in sending, clear tx_in_process to be sure. 
958: 	ipc_socket->tx_status = 0;  // must have no cmd in sending, so clear the tx status too.
959: 
960: 	ipc_socket_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->rx_cmd);
961: 
962: 	return -1;  // don't notify upper layer for further process.
963: }
964: 
965: // disconnect command handler, it is handled internally.
966: static int ipc_socket_rx_cmd_disconnect(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket)
967: {
968: 	if( (ipc_socket->run_state & STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS) != 0 )
969: 	{
970: 		ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_DISCONNECTED;
971: 
972: 		/* tx may be failed. disconnect notification. */
973: 		ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_notify(ipc_socket);
974: 	}
975: 
976: 	ipc_socket->use_flag  &= ~USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
977: 	ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;    // cleared TX_IN_PROCESS.
978: 
979: 	ipc_socket_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->rx_cmd);
980: 
981: 	if(IS_CLIENT_PORT(ipc_socket->src_port))
982: 	{
983: 	//	ipc_socket_rx_notify(ipc_socket);
984: 		return 0;  // need to notify upper layer for further process.
985: 		// if it is a client, notify app to close socket to free resources.
986: 		// server must NOT close socket. it will wait for new connection.
987: 	}
988: 	
989: 	return -1;  // don't notify upper layer for further process.
990: 
991: }

993: static int ipc_socket_rx_cmd_default_handler(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket)
994: {
995: 	// connect/disconnect commands don't check use_flag_connected & wait_tag.
996: 	// other commands need these checks.
997: 	if( (ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_CONNECTED) == 0 )
998: 	{
999: 		ipc_socket_rx_cmd_error_handler(ipc_socket, IPC_API_IMPL_RX_NOT_CONNECT);
1000: 		
1001: 		return -1;  // need not to notify upper layer.
1002: 	}
1003: 
1004: 	if(ipc_socket->rx_tag == ipc_socket->rx_cmd.tag)
1005: 	{
1006: 		// coomand has processed in previously recv, it is a re-sent cmd.
1007: 		ipc_socket_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->rx_cmd);
1008: 
1009: 		return -1;  // need not to notify upper layer.
1010: 	}
1011: 	
1012: //	ipc_socket_rx_notify(ipc_socket);
1013: 
1014: 	return 0;  // need to notify upper layer for further process.
1015: }

1017: static int ipc_socket_rx_cmd_handler(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
1018: {
1019: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
1020: 	{
1021: 		if(ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd == MB_IPC_CONNECT_CMD)  // it is a connect cmd, not includes the connect response.
1022: 		{
1023: 			// try to establish the connection.
1024: 			u32 temp = mb_ipc_enter_critical();
1025: 			ipc_socket = ipc_socket_server_accept(ipc_cmd->dst_port, ipc_cmd->src_cpu, ipc_cmd->src_port);
1026: 			mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
1027: 			if(ipc_socket == NULL)
1028: 			{
1029: 				// no connection for this cmd.
1030: 				return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
1031: 			}
1032: 		}
1033: 		else
1034: 		{
1035: 			// no connection for this cmd.
1036: 			return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
1037: 		}
1038: 	}
1039: 
1040: 	int route_status = IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;  // return to indicate that cmd has reached target. 
1041: 
1042: 	if( ipc_socket->run_state & STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS )	/* has a cmd uncompleted. */
1043: 	{
1044: 		ipc_cmd->api_impl_status = IPC_API_IMPL_RX_BUSY;
1045: 
1046: 		#if 0
1047: 		// send rsp to fail this cmd.
1048: 		ipc_socket_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1049: 		      /* can't call ipc_socket_tx_rsp, because ipc_cmd point to stack memory. */
1050: 		#else
1051: 		route_status = IPC_ROUTE_RX_BUSY;
1052: 		     /*             !!! NOTE !!!                     */
1053: 			 /*       no way to report this fail.            */
1054: 		     /* it is a temporary solution to indicate fail. */
1055: 			 /* actually, it is a API layer fail,            */
1056: 			 /* should return fail state in api_impl_status. */
1057: 		#endif
1058: 	}
1059: 	else  /* it is OK to receive the cmd. */
1060: 	{
1061: 		// save the cmd for further processing.
1062: 		// memcpy(&ipc_socket->rx_cmd, ipc_cmd, sizeof(mb_ipc_cmd_t));
1063: 		ipc_socket->rx_cmd.mb_cmd.hdr.data = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.hdr.data;
1064: 		ipc_socket->rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param1 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1;
1065: 		ipc_socket->rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param2 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2;
1066: 		ipc_socket->rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param3 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3;
1067: 		
1068: 		ipc_socket->rx_read_offset = 0;
1069: 		ipc_socket->run_state |= STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS;
1070: 
1071: 		if( (ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED) == 0 )  // socket must have been initialized.
1072: 		{
1073: 			ipc_socket_rx_cmd_error_handler(ipc_socket, IPC_API_IMPL_NOT_INITED);
1074: 			
1075: 			return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;
1076: 		}
1077: 
1078: 		ipc_socket->rx_cmd.api_impl_status = IPC_API_IMPL_STATUS_OK;  // clear the status before providing to upper layer.
1079: 
1080: 		int  ret_val = 0;
1081: 		
1082: 		/* rx cmd process. */
1083: 		switch(ipc_socket->rx_cmd.hdr.cmd)
1084: 		{
1085: 			case MB_IPC_CONNECT_CMD:
1086: 				ret_val = ipc_socket_rx_cmd_connect(ipc_socket);
1087: 				break;
1088: 
1089: 			case MB_IPC_DISCONNECT_CMD:
1090: 				ret_val = ipc_socket_rx_cmd_disconnect(ipc_socket);
1091: 				break;
1092: 
1093: 			case MB_IPC_SEND_CMD:
1094: 				// no special process, go through to default handler.
1095: 				// break;
1096: 				
1097: 			default:
1098: 				ret_val = ipc_socket_rx_cmd_default_handler(ipc_socket);
1099: 				break;
1100: 		}
1101: 
1102: 		ipc_socket->rx_tag = ipc_socket->rx_cmd.tag;
1103: 
1104: 		if(ret_val == 0)  // need to notify app for further process.
1105: 			ipc_socket_rx_notify(ipc_socket);
1106: 		
1107: 		route_status = IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;  // return to indicate that cmd has reached target.
1108: 		// must return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK !!!!
1109: 		// because the communication is ok, the cmd result will be returned in RSP package.
1110: 	}
1111: 
1112: 	return route_status;
1113: }

1132: static int ipc_socket_local_tx_cmd(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
1133: {
1134: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * tx_ipc_socket = ipc_socket;
1135: 	
1136: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t	  rx_cmd;
1137: 
1138: 	// simulate the mailbox tx and rx process.
1139: 	
1140: 	// simulate local tx, (set tx flag). 
1141: 	// always tx successfully, because target resides in local cpu.
1142: 	ipc_socket->run_state |= STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;
1143: 
1144: 	ipc_socket_set_addr(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1145: 
1146: 	// simulate the target rx. 
1147: 	// copy mailbox data from device registers to statck variable.
1148: 	// memcpy(&rx_cmd, ipc_cmd, sizeof(rx_cmd));  // receive the cmd.
1149: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.hdr.data = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.hdr.data;
1150: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param1 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1;
1151: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param2 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2;
1152: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param3 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3;
1153: 
1154: 	ipc_cmd = &rx_cmd;
1155: 
1156: 	// find the ipc_socket connection for the cmd.
1157: 	ipc_socket = ipc_socket_search_recver(ipc_cmd->dst_port, ipc_cmd->src_cpu, ipc_cmd->src_port);
1158: 
1159: 	ipc_cmd->route_status = ipc_socket_rx_cmd_handler(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1160: 
1161: 	// simulate the local tx complete.
1162: 	ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_handler(tx_ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1163: 
1164: 	// always return tx success, cmd fail is handled in cmd tx_cmpl_handler.
1165: 	return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;
1166: }

1168: static int ipc_socket_local_tx_rsp(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
1169: {
1170: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * tx_ipc_socket = ipc_socket;
1171: 	
1172: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t	  rx_cmd;
1173: 
1174: 	// simulate the mailbox tx and rx process.
1175: 
1176: 	ipc_socket_set_addr(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1177: 
1178: 	ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd |= MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG;   // set to rsp packet.
1179: 	
1180: 	// simulate the target rx. 
1181: 	// copy mailbox data from device registers to statck variable.
1182: 	// memcpy(&rx_cmd, ipc_cmd, sizeof(rx_cmd));  // receive the rsp.
1183: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.hdr.data = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.hdr.data;
1184: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param1 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1;
1185: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param2 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2;
1186: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param3 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3;
1187: 
1188: 	ipc_cmd = &rx_cmd;
1189: 
1190: 	// find the ipc_socket connection for the rsp.
1191: 	ipc_socket = ipc_socket_search_recver(ipc_cmd->dst_port, ipc_cmd->src_cpu, ipc_cmd->src_port);
1192: 
1193: 	// must clear this flag before call peer side rx_rsp_handler.
1194: 	// because, perr side app may send another cmd immediately as soon as tx_in_process is cleared.
1195: 	// if not clear rx_in_process in this side in advances, peer side task may send fail.
1196: 	// tx_ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear rx_in_process.
1197: 
1198: 	// simulate the local tx complete. (will clear STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS in this function)
1199: 	ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_handler(tx_ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1200: 
1201: 	ipc_cmd->route_status = ipc_socket_rx_rsp_handler(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1202: 	// (ipc_cmd->route_status) this status return is worthless but for debug.
1203: 	// so can clear STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS of tx_ipc_socket->run_state in advance.
1204: 
1205: 	// always return tx success, other fails are handled in tx_cmpl_handler.
1206: 	return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;
1207: }

1348: u32 mb_ipc_socket(u8 port, void * rx_callback)
1349: {
1350: 	mb_ipc_socket_handle_t   ipc_handle;
1351: 
1352: 	ipc_handle.data = 0;
1353: 
1354: 	int   port_idx = 0;
1355: 
1356: 	beken_semaphore_t  tx_semaphore = NULL;
1357: 	beken_semaphore_t  rx_semaphore = NULL;
1358: 
1359: 	rtos_init_semaphore(&tx_semaphore, 1);
1360: 	
1361: 	if(tx_semaphore == NULL)
1362: 	{
1363: 		return ipc_handle.data;
1364: 	}
1365: 
1366: 	if(rx_callback == NULL)  // not callback notification
1367: 	{
1368: 		rtos_init_semaphore(&rx_semaphore, 1);
1369: 		
1370: 		if(rx_semaphore == NULL)
1371: 		{
1372: 			rtos_deinit_semaphore(&tx_semaphore);
1373: 			
1374: 			return ipc_handle.data;
1375: 		}
1376: 	}
1377: 
1378: 	u32   temp = mb_ipc_enter_critical();
1379: 	
1380: 	port = ipc_allocate_port(port);
1381: 
1382: 	if(port == 0)
1383: 	{
1384: 		mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
1385: 
1386: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&tx_semaphore);
1387: 		if(rx_semaphore != NULL)
1388: 		{
1389: 			rtos_deinit_semaphore(&rx_semaphore);
1390: 		}
1391: 
1392: 		return ipc_handle.data;
1393: 	}
1394: 
1395: 	if( IS_CLIENT_PORT(port) )
1396: 	{
1397: 		port_idx = port - CLIENT_PORT_MIN;
1398: 
1399: 		ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].tx_notify_sema = tx_semaphore;
1400: 
1401: 		if(rx_callback == NULL)
1402: 		{
1403: 			ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].ctrl_mode |= CTRL_RX_SEMA_NOTIFY; // semaphore notification.
1404: 			ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].rx_notify_sema = rx_semaphore;
1405: 		}
1406: 		else
1407: 		{
1408: 			ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].ctrl_mode &= ~CTRL_RX_SEMA_NOTIFY; // callback notification.
1409: 			ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].rx_notify_isr = (mb_ipc_notify_isr_t)rx_callback;
1410: 		}
1411: 		
1412: 		ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].use_flag = USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED;
1413: 		ipc_handle.data = ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].handle.data;
1414: 		
1415: 	}
1416: 	else if( IS_SERVER_PORT(port) )
1417: 	{
1418: 		port_idx = port - SERVER_PORT_MIN;
1419: 		
1420: 		// the same setting for all clients connected to this server.
1421: 		for(int j = 0; j < MAX_CONNET_PER_SVR; j++)
1422: 		{
1423: 			ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][j].tx_notify_sema = tx_semaphore;
1424: 
1425: 			if(rx_callback == NULL)
1426: 			{
1427: 				ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][j].ctrl_mode |= CTRL_RX_SEMA_NOTIFY; // semaphore notification.
1428: 				ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][j].rx_notify_sema = rx_semaphore;
1429: 			}
1430: 			else
1431: 			{
1432: 				ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][j].ctrl_mode &= ~CTRL_RX_SEMA_NOTIFY; // callback notification.
1433: 				ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][j].rx_notify_isr = (mb_ipc_notify_isr_t)rx_callback;
1434: 			}
1435: 			
1436: 			ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][j].use_flag = USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED;
1437: 		}
1438: 		
1439: 		ipc_handle.data = ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][0].handle.data;
1440: 	}
1441: 
1442: 	mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
1443: 
1444: 	return ipc_handle.data;
1445: }

1447: #define MB_IPC_RETRY_DELAY		2
1448: #define MB_IPC_RETRY_MAX		1
1449: 
1450: int mb_ipc_connect(u32 handle, u8 dst_cpu, u8 dst_port, u32 time_out)
1451: {
1452: 	// data sanity check.
1453: 	if(IS_NOT_SERVER_PORT(dst_port))
1454: 	{
1455: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_PORT;
1456: 	}
1457: 	
1458: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket = get_socket_from_handle(handle);
1459: 
1460: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
1461: 	{
1462: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_HANDLE;
1463: 	}
1464: 
1465: 	// data sanity check.
1466: 	if( (ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED) == 0 )
1467: 	{
1468: 		return -MB_IPC_NOT_INITED;
1469: 	}
1470: 
1471: 	if(ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_CONNECTED)
1472: 	{
1473: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_STATE;
1474: 	}
1475: 
1476: 	// set the dst cpu-port firstly, because the tx_cmd/rx_rsp need these informations.
1477: 	ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = dst_cpu;
1478: 	ipc_socket->dst_port = dst_port;
1479: 	
1480: 	ipc_socket->run_state = 0;
1481: 	ipc_socket->tx_status = 0;
1482: 	ipc_socket->rx_read_offset = 0;
1483: 
1484: 	memset(&ipc_socket->tx_cmd, 0, sizeof(ipc_socket->tx_cmd));
1485: 
1486: 	ipc_socket->tx_cmd.hdr.cmd = MB_IPC_CONNECT_CMD;
1487: 
1488: 	u32   retry = 0;
1489: 	int   ret_val = 0;
1490: 
1491: 	do
1492: 	{
1493: 		rtos_get_semaphore(&ipc_socket->tx_notify_sema, 0);  // clear the semaphore state.
1494: 		
1495: 		int route_status = ipc_socket_tx_cmd(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->tx_cmd, retry);
1496: 		
1497: 		if(route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
1498: 		{
1499: 			ret_val = -(MB_IPC_ROUTE_BASE_FAILED + route_status);
1500: 			break;  // not retry for router error.
1501: 		}
1502: 
1503: 		route_status = rtos_get_semaphore(&ipc_socket->tx_notify_sema, time_out);
1504: 		
1505: 		if(route_status != 0)
1506: 		{
1507: 			ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear tx_in_process. prevent cmd from being handled in ISR.
1508: 			ret_val = -MB_IPC_TX_TIMEOUT;
1509: 			// rtos_delay_milliseconds(MB_IPC_RETRY_DELAY);
1510: 			continue;
1511: 		}
1512: 		
1513: 		if(ipc_socket->tx_status == MB_IPC_TX_OK)
1514: 		{
1515: 			ipc_socket->use_flag |= USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
1516: 			return 0;
1517: 		}
1518: 		else
1519: 		{
1520: 			ret_val = -ipc_socket->tx_status;
1521: 			break;  // not retry.
1522: 		}
1523: 
1524: 	} while((ret_val != 0) && (++retry < MB_IPC_RETRY_MAX));
1525: 
1526: 	// if(ret_val != 0)  // must be TRUE.
1527: 	{
1528: 		ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = 0;
1529: 		ipc_socket->dst_port = 0;  // clear the connection.
1530: 	}
1531: 
1532: 	return ret_val;
1533: }

1535: int mb_ipc_disconnect(u32 handle, u8 dst_cpu, u8 dst_port, u32 time_out)
1536: {
1537: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket = get_socket_from_handle(handle);
1538: 
1539: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
1540: 	{
1541: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_HANDLE;
1542: 	}
1543: 
1544: 	// data sanity check.
1545: 	if( (ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED) == 0 )
1546: 	{
1547: 		return -MB_IPC_NOT_INITED;
1548: 	}
1549: 
1550: 	if(dst_port == 0)
1551: 	{

1559: 	ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear tx_in_process. prevent previous cmd from being handled in ISR.

1562:

1566: 	int   ret_val = 0;
1567:

1569: 	{

1581: 		
1582: 		if(route_status != 0)

1588: 		}
1589: 
1590: 		if(ipc_socket->dst_port == 0)
1591: 		{
1592: 			ipc_socket->use_flag &= ~USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
1593: 			return 0;
1594: 		}
1595: 
1596: 		if(ipc_socket->tx_status == MB_IPC_TX_OK)

1600: 			
1601: 			ipc_socket->use_flag &= ~USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;

125: static void ipc_cmd_rx_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
126: {
127: 	u32		result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
128: 	mb_chnl_ack_t * ack_buf = (mb_chnl_ack_t *)cmd_buf;
129: 	ipc_cmd_t     * ipc_cmd = (ipc_cmd_t *)cmd_buf;
130: 
131: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == ipc_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
132: 
133: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_FLAG)  /* ipc rsp from other CPU. */
134: 	{
135: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* unsolicited ipc response. */
136: 		{
137: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
138: 		}
139: 
140: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd != (cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_MASK))
141: 		{
142: 			/* un-matched rpc response. */
143: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
144: 		}
145: 
146: 		/* communication ok, function is completed. */
147: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
148: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
149: 
150: 		BK_LOGI(MOD_TAG, "IPC_RSP_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
151: 
152: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
153: 		{
154: 			/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
155: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
156: 			chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
157: 		}
158: 		else
159: 		{
160: 			/* returns ACK_STATE_COMPLETE, 
161: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
162: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
163: 			{
164: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
165: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
166: 				#endif
167: 				
168: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
169: 
170: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
171: 			}
172: 			else
173: 			{
174: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
175: 			}
176: 		}
177: 
178: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
179: 
180: 		ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
181: 
182: 		/* it is a rsp command, nothing need to be returned. */
183: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_buff = NULL;
184: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
185: 
186: 		result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
187: 
188: 		goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
189: 	}
190: 	else
191: 	{
192: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
193: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 1;
194: 
195: 		BK_LOGD(MOD_TAG, "IPC_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
196: 
197: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->cmd_buf))

199: 			result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
200: 		}

204: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */

206: 			{
207: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
208: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
209: 				#endif
210: 				
211: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->cmd_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
212: 
213: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
214: 			}
215: 			else
216: 			{
217: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = 0;
218: 			}
219: 
220: 			result = chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler(chnl_cb, ack_buf);
221: 		}
222: 
223: 		if(result != ACK_STATE_PENDING)
224: 			chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 0;
225: 	}
226: 
227: ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit:
228: 
229: 	/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle complete.
230: 	 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
231: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
232: 	 */
233: 	ack_buf->ack_state = result;
234: 
235: 	return;
236: 
237: }

239: static void ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
240: {
241: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.cmd == chnl_cb->tx_cmd)
242: 	{
243: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* RSP_CMD rx_isr may arrive before this tx_cmpl_isr. */
244: 			return;
245: 
246: 		/* IPC cmd tx complete. */
247: 
248: 		if( (ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) 
249: 			|| (ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_FAIL) )
250: 		{
251: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
252: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;
253: 
254: 			/* communication failed or function failed. */
255: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
256: 		}
257: 		else if(ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_COMPLETE)
258: 		{
259: 			/* communication ok, function is completed. */
260: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
261: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
262: 
263: 			ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
264: 
265: 			/* chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == ipc_rsp->rsp_buff. MUST be true. */
266: 
267: 			if(ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
268: 			{
269: 				/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
270: 				chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
271: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
272: 			}
273: 			else
274: 			{
275: 				if((ipc_rsp->rsp_buff != NULL) && (ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > 0))
276: 				{
277: 					#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
278: 					flush_dcache(ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);;
279: 					#endif
280: 
281: 					memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
282: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len;
283: 				}
284: 				else
285: 				{
286: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
287: 				}
288: 			}
289: 			
290: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
291: 		}
292: 		else
293: 		{
294: 			/* communication ok, function is pending. */
295: 		}
296: 
297: 		return;
298: 	}
299: 
300: 	/*
301: 	 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
302: 	 */
303: 	BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault in %s,cmd:%d\r\n", __func__, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
304: 
305: 	return;
306: 
307: }

309: static bk_err_t ipc_chnl_init(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id, ipc_rx_cmd_hdlr_t rx_handler)
310: {
311: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
312: 
313: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
314: 		return BK_OK;
315: 
316: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(ipc_chnl_cb_t));
317: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
318: 
319: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
320: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
321: 
322: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) || 
323: 		(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
324: 	{
325: 		return BK_FAIL;
326: 	}
327: 
328: 	ret_code = rtos_init_semaphore_adv(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, 1, 1);
329: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
330: 	{
331: 		return ret_code;
332: 	}
333: 
334: 	ret_code = rtos_init_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, 1);
335: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
336: 	{
337: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
338: 
339: 		return ret_code;
340: 	}
341: 
342: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
343: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
344: 	{
345: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
346: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
347: 
348: 		return ret_code;
349: 	}
350: 
351: 	chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler = rx_handler;
352: 
353: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)ipc_cmd_rx_isr);
354: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr);
355: 
356: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 1;
357: 
358: 	return BK_OK;
359: }

361: static bk_err_t ipc_send_cmd(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 cmd, u8 *cmd_buf, u16 cmd_len, u8 * rsp_buf, u16 rsp_buf_len)
362: {
363: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
364: 	ipc_cmd_t	ipc_cmd;
365: 
366: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
367: 		return BK_FAIL;
368: 
369: 	rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
370: 
371: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = cmd;
372: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
373: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 1;
374: 
375: 	void * dst_buf = (void *)chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff;
376: 
377: 	do
378: 	{
379: 		if(cmd_len > IPC_XCHG_DATA_MAX)
380: 		{
381: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
382: 			break;
383: 		}
384: 
385: 		if(cmd_buf == NULL)
386: 			cmd_len = 0;
387: 
388: 		if(cmd_len > 0)
389: 			memcpy(dst_buf, cmd_buf, cmd_len);
390: 
391: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.data = 0;	/* clear hdr. */
392: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = cmd;
393: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_buff      = dst_buf;
394: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cmd_len;
395: 
396: 		ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&ipc_cmd);
397: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
398: 		{
399: 			break;
400: 		}
401: 
402: 		ret_val = rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, IPC_RSP_TIMEOUT);  /* isr_callback will set this semaphore. */
403: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
404: 		{
405: 			mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_cb->chnl_id, MB_CHNL_TX_RESET, NULL);
406: 			break;
407: 		}
408: 
409: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;  /* must have been set to 0 by callback. */
410: 
411: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed)
412: 		{
413: 			ret_val = BK_FAIL;
414: 			break;
415: 		}
416: 
417: 		if((rsp_buf == NULL) || (rsp_buf_len == 0))
418: 		{
419: 			ret_val = BK_OK;
420: 			break;
421: 		}
422: 
423: 		if(rsp_buf_len < chnl_cb->rsp_len)
424: 		{
425: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
426: 			break;
427: 		}
428: 
429: 		if(chnl_cb->rsp_len > 0)
430: 			memcpy(rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_len);
431: 
432: 		ret_val = BK_OK;
433: 
434: 	}while(0);
435: 
436: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
437: 
438: 	rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
439: 
440: 	return ret_val;
441: 
442: }

513: 				if(amp_res_available(res_id) == BK_OK)

516: 				}
517: 				else
518: 				{
519: 					result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
520: 				}
521: 			}
522: 			else
523: 			{
524: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
525: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
526: 			}
527: 			break;
528: 
529: 		case IPC_TEST_CMD:

531: 			{

534: 				u32 * p_src = (u32 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
535: 				u32 * p_dst = (u32 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;

537: 				*p_dst = (*p_src) + 1;

539: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
540: 			}
541: 			else
542: 			{

561: #if (USB_CDC_CP1_IPC)

708: 		case IPC_SET_CPU1_HEART_RATE:

721: 			{

723: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;

742: 		case IPC_RES_ACQUIRE_CNT:
743: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(ipc_res_req_t))
744: 			{

751: 				ipc_exit_critical(int_mask);

943: static int mb_ipc_heartbeat_timeout(void)
944: {
945: 	u32   cur_time;
946: 
947: 	cur_time = (u32)rtos_get_time();
948: 
949: 	if(cpu1_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
950: 	{
951: 		return 0;
952: 	}
953: 	if((cpu1_state == CORE_STARTING) || (cpu1_dump != 0))
954: 	{
955: 		cpu1_heartbeat_timestamp = cur_time;
956: 		return 0;
957: 	}
958: 
959: 	if(cur_time >= cpu1_heartbeat_timestamp)
960: 	{
961: 		cur_time -= cpu1_heartbeat_timestamp;
962: 	}
963: 	else
964: 	{
965: 		cur_time += (~(cpu1_heartbeat_timestamp)) + 1;  // wrap around. 
966: 	}
967: 	
968: 	if(cur_time < CONFIG_INT_WDT_PERIOD_MS)
969: 	{
970: 		cpu1_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
971: 		return 0;
972: 	}
973: 
974: 	return 1;
975: }

977: static void mb_ipc_task( void *para )
978: {
979: 	bk_err_t	ret_val;
980: 	u32    events;
981: 	u32    check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
982: 	
983: 	ret_val = rtos_init_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event);
984: 
985: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
986: 	{
987: 		rtos_delete_thread(NULL);
988: 		return;
989: 	}
990: 
991: 	while(1)
992: 	{
993: 		events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_ALL_FLAGS, true, check_time);
994: 
995: 		if(events == 0)
996: 		{
997: 			// timeout, so check heartbeat.
998: 			events = MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG;
999: 		}
1000: 
1001: 		if(events & MB_IPC_STOP_CORE_FLAG)  // process this event at first!!!!
1002: 		{
1003: 			if(cpu1_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
1004: 			{
1005: 				events = 0;  // clear all events.
1006: 			}
1007: 		}
1008: 		
1009: 		if(events & MB_IPC_START_CORE_FLAG)
1010: 		{
1011: 			u8   retry_cnt = 0;
1012: 
1013: 			while(cpu1_state == CORE_STARTING)
1014: 			{
1015: 				mb_ipc_heartbeat_timeout();
1016: 				
1017: 				if(events & MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG)
1018: 				{
1019: 					if(cpu1_state == CORE_STARTING)
1020: 					{
1021: 						cpu1_state = CORE_POWER_ON;
1022: 						break;  // cpu1 power on. 
1023: 					}
1024: 				}
1025: 				else
1026: 				{
1027: 					if(retry_cnt > 0)
1028: 					{
1029: 						BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC retry to start core1\r\n");
1030: 						stop_cpu1_core();
1031: 						rtos_delay_milliseconds(6);
1032: 						start_cpu1_core();
1033: 						break;
1034: 					}
1035: 					else
1036: 					{
1037: 						events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG, true, 2000);// 2s
1038: 					}
1039: 				}
1040: 
1041: 				retry_cnt++;
1042: 			}
1043: 
1044: 			// discard this event when not in CORE_STARTING state.
1045: 		}
1046: 		
1047: 		if(events & MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG)
1048: 		{
1049: 			if(mb_ipc_heartbeat_timeout())
1050: 			{
1051: 				BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC restart core1\r\n");
1052: 				stop_cpu1_core();
1053: 				rtos_delay_milliseconds(6);
1054: 				start_cpu1_core();
1055: 			}
1056: 		}
1057: 
1058: 		if(cpu1_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
1059: 		{
1060: 			check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
1061: 		}
1062: 		else
1063: 		{
1064: 			check_time = CONFIG_INT_WDT_PERIOD_MS;
1065: 		}
1066: 	}
1067: }

73: #define MB_IPC_ALL_FLAGS			(MB_IPC_START_CORE_FLAG | MB_IPC_STOP_CORE_FLAG | MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG | MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG)
74: 
75: enum
76: {
77: 	CORE_POWER_OFF = 0,
78: 	CORE_STARTING,
79: 	CORE_POWER_ON,
80: };
81: 
82: static rtos_event_ext_t		mb_ipc_heart_event;
83: static u32             cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = 0;
84: static volatile u8     cpu_x_state = CORE_POWER_OFF;
85: static volatile u8     cpu_x_id = 0xFF;   /* invalid ID, */
86: static volatile u8     cpu_x_dump = 0;
87: 
88: extern void start_cpu1_core(void);
89: extern void stop_cpu1_core(void);
90: extern void start_cpu2_core(void);
91: extern void stop_cpu2_core(void);
92: 
93: static int ipc_heartbeat_timeout(void)
94: {
95: 	u32   cur_time;
96: 
97: 	cur_time = (u32)rtos_get_time();
98: 
99: 	if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
100: 	{
101: 		return 0;
102: 	}
103: 	if((cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING) || (cpu_x_dump != 0))
104: 	{
105: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = cur_time;
106: 		return 0;
107: 	}
108: 
109: 	if(cur_time >= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)
110: 	{
111: 		cur_time -= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp;
112: 	}
113: 	else
114: 	{
115: 		cur_time += (~(cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)) + 1;  // wrap around. 
116: 	}
117: 	
118: 	if(cur_time < CONFIG_INT_WDT_PERIOD_MS)
119: 	{
120: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
121: 		return 0;
122: 	}
123: 
124: 	return 1;
125: }
126: 
127: static void restart_cpu_x(void)
128: {
129: 	if(cpu_x_id == 1)
130: 	{
131: 		stop_cpu1_core();
132: 		rtos_delay_milliseconds(6);
133: 		start_cpu1_core();
134: 		return;
135: 	}
136: 	
137: 	if(cpu_x_id == 2)
138: 	{
139: 		stop_cpu2_core();
140: 		rtos_delay_milliseconds(6);
141: 		start_cpu2_core();
142: 		return;
143: 	}
144: }
145: 
146: static int check_cpu_id_ok(u32 cpu_id)
147: {
148: 	if(cpu_x_id == 0xFF)
149: 	{
150: 		cpu_x_id = cpu_id;
151: 		return 1;
152: 	}
153: 
154: 	if(cpu_x_id != cpu_id)
155: 	{
156: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "can't manage multiple cpus!\r\n");
157: 		return 0;
158: 	}
159: 
160: 	return 1;
161: }
162: 
163: static void mb_ipc_task( void *para )
164: {
165: 	bk_err_t	ret_val;
166: 	u32    events;
167: 	u32    check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
168: 	
169: 	ret_val = rtos_init_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event);
170: 
171: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
172: 	{
173: 		rtos_delete_thread(NULL);
174: 		return;
175: 	}
176: 
177: 	while(1)
178: 	{
179: 		events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_ALL_FLAGS, true, check_time);
180: 
181: 		if(events == 0)
182: 		{
183: 			// timeout, so check heartbeat.
184: 			events = MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG;
185: 		}
186: 
187: 		if(events & MB_IPC_STOP_CORE_FLAG)  // process this event at first!!!!
188: 		{
189: 			if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
190: 			{
191: 				events = 0;  // clear all events.
192: 			}
193: 		}
194: 		
195: 		if(events & MB_IPC_START_CORE_FLAG)
196: 		{
197: 			u8   retry_cnt = 0;
198: 
199: 			while(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
200: 			{
201: 				ipc_heartbeat_timeout();
202: 				
203: 				if(events & MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG)
204: 				{
205: 					if(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
206: 					{
207: 						cpu_x_state = CORE_POWER_ON;
208: 						break;  // cpu1 power on. 
209: 					}
210: 				}
211: 				else
212: 				{
213: 					if(retry_cnt > 0)
214: 					{
215: 						BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC retry to start core%d\r\n", cpu_x_id);
216: 						// restart_cpu_x();
217: 						break;
218: 					}
219: 					else
220: 					{
221: 						events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG, true, 2000);
222: 					}
223: 				}
224: 
225: 				retry_cnt++;
226: 			}
227: 
228: 			// discard this event when not in CORE_STARTING state.
229: 		}
230: 		
231: 		if(events & MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG)
232: 		{
233: 			if(ipc_heartbeat_timeout())
234: 			{
235: 				BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC heartbeat timeout%d\r\n", cpu_x_id);
236: 				/*when cpu1 heatbeat timerout, then system reboot*/
237: 				BK_ASSERT(false);
238: 				// restart_cpu_x();
239: 			}
240: 		}
241: 
242: 		if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
243: 		{
244: 			check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
245: 		}
246: 		else
247: 		{
248: 			check_time = CONFIG_INT_WDT_PERIOD_MS;
249: 		}
250: 	}
251: }

253: void mb_ipc_reset_notify(u32 cpu_id, u32 power_on)
254: {
255: 	if(check_cpu_id_ok(cpu_id) == 0)
256: 	{
257: 		return;
258: 	}
259: 	
260: 	if(power_on)
261: 	{
262: 		if(cpu_x_state != CORE_POWER_ON)
263: 		{
264: 			cpu_x_state = CORE_STARTING;
265: 			rtos_set_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_START_CORE_FLAG);
266: 		}
267: 	}
268: 	else
269: 	{
270: 		cpu_x_state = CORE_POWER_OFF;
271: 		rtos_set_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_STOP_CORE_FLAG);
272: 	}
273: }
274: 
275: void mb_ipc_heartbeat_notify(u32 cpu_id)
276: {
277: 	if(check_cpu_id_ok(cpu_id) == 0)
278: 	{
279: 		return;
280: 	}
281: 	
282: 	rtos_set_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG);
283: }
284: 
285: void mb_ipc_power_on_notify(u32 cpu_id)
286: {
287: 	if(check_cpu_id_ok(cpu_id) == 0)
288: 	{
289: 		return;
290: 	}
291: 	
292: 	rtos_set_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG);
293: }
294: 
295: void mb_ipc_dump_notify(u32 cpu_id, u32 dump)
296: {
297: 	if(check_cpu_id_ok(cpu_id) == 0)
298: 	{
299: 		return;
300: 	}
301: 	
302: 	cpu_x_dump = (dump != 0);
303: }
304: 
305: int mb_ipc_cpu_is_power_on(u32 cpu_id)
306: {
307: 	if((cpu_x_id == 0xFF) || (cpu_x_id != cpu_id))
308: 	{
309: 		return 0;
310: 	}
311: 	
312: 	if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_ON)
313: 	{
314: 		return 1;
315: 	}
316: 
317: 	return 0;
318: }
319: 
320: int mb_ipc_cpu_is_power_off(u32 cpu_id)
321: {
322: 	if((cpu_x_id == 0xFF) || (cpu_x_id != cpu_id))
323: 	{
324: 		return 1;
325: 	}
326: 	
327: 	if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
328: 	{
329: 		return 1;
330: 	}
331: 
332: 	return 0;
333: }
334: 
335: #endif

338: 
339: #define MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_TIME		2000
340: 
341: static void mb_ipc_task( void *para )
342: {
343: 	ipc_send_power_up();
344: 
345: 	while(1)
346: 	{
347: 		rtos_delay_milliseconds(MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_TIME);
348: 		ipc_send_heart_beat(0);
349: 	}
350: }
351: 
352: #endif

354: bk_err_t mb_ipc_heartbeat_init(void)
355: {
356: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
357: 
358: #if defined(MASTER_HB_TASK) || defined(SLAVE_HB_TASK)
359: 	ret_val = rtos_create_thread(NULL, BEKEN_DEFAULT_WORKER_PRIORITY, "heartbeat", mb_ipc_task, 1536, 0);
360: #endif
361: 
362: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
363: 	{
364: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "heartbeat task failed at line %d: %d\r\n", __LINE__, ret_val);
365: 	}
366: 
367: 	return ret_val;	
368: }
369: 
370: #endif

164: static u8 mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
165: {
166: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
167: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
168: 	u16 			chnl_type;
169: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
170: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
171: 
172: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
173: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
174: 
175: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
176: 		return 4;
177: 
178: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
179: 		return 5;
180: 
181: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
182: 		return 3;
183: 
184: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
185: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
186: 
187: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
188: 		return 1;
189: 
190: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
191: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
192: 
193: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
194: 
195: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
196: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
197: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
198: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
199: 
200: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
201: 
202: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
203: 
204: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
205: 
206: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
207: 
208: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
209: 	{
210: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
211: 
212: 		return 2;
213: 	}
214: 
215: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_ILDE;
216: 
217: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
218: 	{
219: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
220: 	}
221: 
222: 	return 0;
223: }

225: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
226: {
227: 	u8		log_chnl;
228: 	u8		ret_code;
229: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
230: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
231: 
232: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
233: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
234: 
235: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
236: 
237: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
238: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
239: 
240: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
241: 		return;
242: 
243: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
244: 		return;
245: 
246: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
247: 		return;
248: 
249: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
250: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
251: 
252: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
253: 		return;
254: 
255: #if CONFIG_SYS_CPU0
256: 	if(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
257: 	{
258: 		if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_ILDE)
259: 		{
260: 			return;
261: 		}
262: 
263: 		ack_ptr->hdr.data = 0;
264: 		ack_ptr->hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
265: 		ack_ptr->hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
266: 
267: 		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
268: 
269: 		if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
270: 			return;
271: 
272: 		extern bk_err_t bk_mailbox_ready(mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, uint32_t box_id);
273: 		if( bk_mailbox_ready(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx, MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL) != BK_OK)
274: 		{
275: 			return;
276: 		}
277: 
278: 		log_chnl = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl;
279: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
280: 
281: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
282: 
283: 		ack_ptr->data1 = log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff.param1;
284: 		ack_ptr->data2 = log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff.param2;
285: 		ack_ptr->data3 = log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff.param3;
286: 	}
287: 	else
288: #endif
289: 
290: 	if( (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
291: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) )
292: 	{
293: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
294: 
295: 		return;
296: 	}
297: 
298: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
299: 	{
300: 		/* clear following header members. */
301: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
302: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
303: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
304: 
305: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
306: 
307: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
308: 	}
309: 	
310: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
311: 	{
312: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_ILDE)
313: 			break;
314: 	}
315: 
316: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
317: 	{
318: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_ILDE;
319: 		return;
320: 	}
321: 
322: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
323: 
324: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
325: 
326: 	if(ret_code != 0)
327: 	{
328: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_ILDE;
329: 		return;
330: 	}
331: 
332: 	return;
333: 
334: }

336: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
337: {
338: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
339: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
340: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
341: 	u16 		chnl_type;
342: 
343: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
344: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
345: 
346: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
347: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
348: 
349: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
350: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
351: 
352: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
353: 		return;
354: 
355: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
356: 		return;
357: 
358: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
359: 		return;
360: 
361: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
362: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
363: 
364: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
365: 
366: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
367: 	{
368: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
369: 
370: 		return;
371: 	}
372: 
373: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
374: 	{
375: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
376: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
377: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
378: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
379: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
380: 
381: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
382: 
383: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
384: 	}
385: 	else
386: 	{
387: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
388: 	}
389: 
390: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
391: 	{
392: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
393: 		return;
394: 	}
395: 
396: 	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
397: 
398: 	/* RE-USE the cmd buffer for ACK !!! */
399: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
400: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
401: 
402: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
403: 
404: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
405: 
406: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
407: 
408: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
409: 	{
410: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
411: 
412: 		return;
413: 	}
414: 
415: 	return;
416: }
417: 
418: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
419: {
420: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
421: 
422: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
423: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
424: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
425: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
426: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
427: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
428: 
429: 	/*
430: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
431: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
432: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
433: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
434: 	 */
435: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
436: 	{
437: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
438: 	}
439: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
440: 	{
441: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
442: 	}
443: }

445: static void mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
446: {
447: 	u8		ret_code;
448: 
449: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
450: 
451: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
452: 
453: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
454: 
455: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
456: 		return;
457: 
458: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
459: 		return;
460: 
461: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
462: 
463: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_ILDE)
464: 	{
465: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
466: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
467: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
468: 
469: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
470: 
471: 		if(ret_code != 0)
472: 		{
473: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_ILDE;
474: 		}
475: 	}
476: 
477: 	return;
478: }

480: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
481: {
482: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
483: 	u16 			chnl_type;
484: 
485: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
486: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
487: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
488: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
489: 
490: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
491: 
492: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
493: 
494: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
495: 
496: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
497: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
498: 
499: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
500: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
501: 
502: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
503: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
504: 
505: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
506: 
507: 	/*
508: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_ILDE here,
509: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_ILDE in interrupt callback.
510: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
511: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
512: 	 */
513: 	while(1)
514: 	{
515: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
516: 
517: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
518: 		{
519: 			break;
520: 		}
521: 	}
522: 
523: 	return ret_code;
524: }

574: /*
575:   * init logical chnanel module.
576:   * return:
577:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
578:   *     failed  : fail code.
579:   *
580:   */
581: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
582: {
583: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
584: 	int				i, j;
585: 
586: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
587: 
588: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
589: 	{
590: 		return BK_OK;
591: 	}

594: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
595: 	{
596: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_ILDE;
597: 
598: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);

600: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
601: 
602: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
603: 		{
604: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_ILDE;
605: 		}
606: 	}
607: 
608: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
609: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
610: 	{
611: 		return ret_code;
612: 	}
613: 
614: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
615: 
616: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
617: 	{
618: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
619: 
620: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
621: 	}
622: 
623: #if (CONFIG_SYS_CPU1)
624: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
625: 	{

632: 	return BK_OK;

635: /*
636:   * open logical chnanel.
637:   * input:

639:   *     callback_param : param passsed to all callbacks.

641:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
642:   *     failed  : fail code.
643:   *
644:   */
645: bk_err_t mb_chnl_open(u8 log_chnl, void * callback_param)
646: {
647: 	if(!mb_chnnl_init_ok)	/* if driver is not initialized. */
648: 	{
649: 		bk_err_t		ret_code;
650: 
651: 		ret_code = mb_chnl_init();
652: 
653: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)

655: 			return ret_code;

657: 	}

659: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
660: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
661: 
662: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
663: 
664: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
665: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
666: 
667: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
668: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
669: 
670: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
671: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
672: 
673: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);

687: /*
688:   * close logical chnanel.
689:   * input:
690:   *     log_chnl  : logical channel id to close.
691:   * return:
692:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
693:   *     failed  : fail code.
694:   *
695:   */
696: bk_err_t mb_chnl_close(u8 log_chnl)
697: {
698: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
699: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
700: 
701: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
702: 
703: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
704: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
705: 
706: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
707: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
708: 
709: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
710: 
711: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
712: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
713: 
714: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
715: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
716: 
717: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used = 0;
718: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_ILDE;
719: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr = NULL;
720: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr = NULL;
721: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr = NULL;
722:

729:   * read from logical chnanel.
730:   * input:
731:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to read.
732:   *     read_buf       : buffer to receive channel cmd data.
733:   * return:
734:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
735:   *     failed  : fail code.
736:   *

738: bk_err_t mb_chnl_read(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * read_buf)
739: {

743: /*
744:   * write to logical chnanel.
745:   * input:
746:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to write.
747:   *     cmd_buf     : buffer of channel cmd data.
748:   * return:
749:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
750:   *     failed  : fail code.
751:   *
752:   */
753: bk_err_t mb_chnl_write(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * cmd_buf)
754: {
755: 	u16		write_len;
756: 
757: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
758: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
759: 
760: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
761: 
762: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
763: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
764: 
765: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
766: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
767: 
768: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
769: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
770: 
771: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
772: 
773: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
774: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
775: 
776: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
777: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
778: 
779: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
780: 
781: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_ILDE)
782: 	{
783: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
784: 		
785: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
786: 	}
787: 
788: 	write_len = sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) ? sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) : sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
789: 
790: 	memcpy(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, cmd_buf, write_len);
791: 
792: 	/* set to BUSY means there is data in tx-buff. mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr will get it to send. */
793: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;   /* MUST set to BUSY after data was copied. */
794: 
795: 	mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(log_chnl);
796: 
797: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
798: 
799: 	return BK_OK;
800: }

802: /*
803:   * logical chnanel misc io (set/get param).
804:   * input:
805:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to set/get param.
806:   *     cmd          : control command for logical channel.
807:   *     param      :  parameter of the command.
808:   * return:
809:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
810:   *     failed  : fail code.
811:   *
812:   */
813: bk_err_t mb_chnl_ctrl(u8 log_chnl, u8 cmd, void * param)
814: {
815: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
816: 
817: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
818: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);

820: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
821: 
822: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
823: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
824: 
825: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
826: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
827: 
828: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
829: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
830: 
831: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
832: 
833: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
834: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
835: 
836: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
837: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
838: 
839: 	switch(cmd)
840: 	{
841: 		case MB_CHNL_GET_STATUS:
842: 
843: 			if(param == NULL)
844: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
845: 
846: 			*((u8 *)param) = log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state;
847: 			
848: 			break;
849: 
850: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR:
851: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr = (chnl_rx_isr_t)param;
852: 			break;
853: 
854: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR:
855: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr = (chnl_tx_isr_t)param;
856: 			break;
857: 
858: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR:
859: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr = (chnl_tx_cmpl_isr_t)param;
860: 			break;
861: 
862: 		case MB_CHNL_WRITE_SYNC:
863: 			if(param == NULL)
864: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
865: 
866: 			ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(log_chnl, (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)param);
867: 			return ret_code;
868: 			break;
869: 
870: 		case MB_CHNL_TX_RESET:
871: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_ILDE; 
872: 			ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_reset(log_chnl);
873: 			return ret_code;
874: 			break;
875: 
876: 		default:
877: 			return BK_ERR_NOT_SUPPORT;
878: 			break;
879: 	}
880: 
881: 	return BK_OK;
882: }

52: {
53: 	mailbox_box_num_t box;

55: 
56: 	MAILBOX_LOGD("%s hw %p\n", __func__, hal->hw);
57: 
58: 	box = mailbox_hal_check_which_box_trigger(hal);
59: 	if (box == MAILBOX_NONE) {
60: 		MAILBOX_LOGD("%s BOX ERROR\n", __func__);
61: 		return;
62: 	}
63: 
64: 	// Receive Data
65: 	mailbox_receive_data(hal, &data, box);
66: 
67: 	// Handle MBOX Data
68: 	crosscore_mb_rx_isr(&data);
69: 
70: 	// Clear Int, Sender MBOX will clear ready bit
71: 	mailbox_hal_box_clear(hal, box);
72: 
73: 	MAILBOX_LOGD("[RECIVE_R]: (%08x, 0x%08x, %d, %d)\r\n", data.param0,
74: 				 data.param1, data.param2, data.param3);
75: 
76: 	MAILBOX_LOGD("%s OUT\n\n", __func__);

80: {
81: 	mailbox_box_num_t box;
82: 	int wait_count = 0;
83: 
84: 	MAILBOX_LOGD("%s\n", __func__);
85: 	MAILBOX_LOGD("mailbox %p send to %d\n", hal->hw, dst);
86: 
87: 	while (wait_count < MAILBOX_SEND_WAIT_COUNT) {
88: 		box = mailbox_hal_check_which_box_ready(hal);
89: 
90: 		if (box != MAILBOX_NONE)
91: 			break;
92: 		wait_count++;
93: 	}
94: 
95: 	if (box == MAILBOX_NONE) {// mailbox busy
96: 		MAILBOX_LOGD("No MailBox left for %d\n", dst);
97: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT;
98: 	}
99: 
100: 	MAILBOX_LOGD("BOX: %x param0: %x, param1: %x, param2: %x, param3: %x\r\n",
101: 				 box, data->param0, data->param1, data->param2, data->param3);
102: 
103: 	// mailbox_hal_box_clear_ready(hal, box);
104: 	mailbox_write_data(hal, data, box);
105: 	mailbox_hal_box_trigger(hal, box);
106: 
107: 	return BK_OK;
108: }

178: 	id = mailbox_check_src_dst(src, dst);
179: 	if (id >= ARRAY_SIZE(mailbox_cfg_map_table))
180: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
181: 
182: 	MAILBOX_LOGD("mailbox send to %d\n", dst);
183: 	MAILBOX_LOGD("%s addr is %x! id: %d\n", __func__, (s_mailbox[id].hal), id);
184: 
185: 	if(arg == NULL)
186: 	{
187: 		int wait_count = 0;
188: 
189: 		while(wait_count < MAILBOX_SEND_WAIT_COUNT)
190: 		{
191: 			box = mailbox_hal_check_which_box_ready(&(s_mailbox[id].hal));
192: 
193: 			if (box != MAILBOX_NONE)
194: 			{
195: 				break;
196: 			}
197: 			wait_count++;
198: 		}
199: 
200: 		if (box == MAILBOX_NONE) // mailbox busy
201: 			return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT;
202: 	}
203: 	else
204: 	{
205: 		box = (*(uint16_t *)arg) & 0xFF;
206: 
207: 		if ((box != MAILBOX_BOX0) && (box != MAILBOX_BOX1))
208: 		{
209: 			return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_ID;
210: 		}
211: 
212: 		if(mailbox_hal_read_box_ready(&(s_mailbox[id].hal), box) != 0)
213: 		{
214: 			return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT;  // mailbox busy
215: 		}
216: 	}
217: 
218: 	MAILBOX_LOGD("BOX: %x param0: %x, param1: %x, param2: %x, param3: %x\r\n",
219: 			      box, data->param0, data->param1, data->param2, data->param3);
220: 
221: 	mailbox_hal_box_clear_ready(&(s_mailbox[id].hal), box);
222: 	mailbox_write_data(data, id, box);
223: 	mailbox_hal_box_trigger(&(s_mailbox[id].hal), box);
224: 
225: 	return BK_OK;
226: 
227: }

76: /* call this API in interrupt disabled state. */
77: bk_err_t amp_res_acquire_cnt(u16 res_id, u16 cpu_id, amp_res_req_cnt_t *cnt_list)
78: {
79: 	if(res_id >= AMP_RES_ID_MAX)
80: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
81: 
82: 	if(amp_res_sync[res_id].inited == 0)
83: 		return BK_ERR_NOT_INIT;
84: 
85: 	if(cpu_id >= AMP_CPU_CNT)
86: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
87: 
88: 	u16		i = 0;
89: 	u16 	all_cnt = 0;
90: 	
91: 	for(i = 0; i < AMP_CPU_CNT; i++)
92: 	{
93: 		all_cnt += amp_res_sync[res_id].req_cnt[i];
94: 	}
95: 
96: 	cnt_list->self_req_cnt = amp_res_sync[res_id].req_cnt[cpu_id];
97: 	cnt_list->others_req_cnt = all_cnt - cnt_list->self_req_cnt;
98: 
99: 	amp_res_sync[res_id].req_cnt[cpu_id]++;
100: 
101: 	return BK_OK;
102: 	
103: }

107: {
108: 	if(res_id >= AMP_RES_ID_MAX)
109: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;

120: 	{
121: 		amp_res_sync[res_id].req_cnt[cpu_id]--;
122: 
123: 		u16 	all_cnt = 0;
124: 
125: 		for(i = 0; i < AMP_CPU_CNT; i++)
126: 		{
127: 			all_cnt += amp_res_sync[res_id].req_cnt[i];
128: 		}
129: 
130: 		cnt_list->self_req_cnt = amp_res_sync[res_id].req_cnt[cpu_id];
131: 		cnt_list->others_req_cnt = all_cnt - cnt_list->self_req_cnt;
132: 
133: 		return BK_OK;
134: 	}
135: 	else
136: 	{
137: 		return BK_FAIL;
138: 	}

140: }

163: 
164: #ifdef AMP_RES_SERVER
165:

172: #else

182: bk_err_t amp_res_lock_acquire(u16 res_id, u32 timeout_ms, const char * func_name, int line_no)
183: {
184: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
185: 
186: 	if (!rtos_is_scheduler_started()) {
187: 		return BK_OK;
188: 	}
189: 
190: 	if( rtos_is_in_interrupt_context() )
191: 	{
192: 		BK_LOGE("AMP", "can't call in ISR %s,%d\r\n", func_name, line_no);
193: 
194: 		return BK_FAIL;
195: 	}
196: 
197: 	if(res_id >= AMP_RES_ID_MAX)
198: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
199: 
200: 	if(amp_res_sync[res_id].inited == 0)
201: 		return BK_ERR_NOT_INIT;
202: 
203: 	amp_res_req_cnt_t	cnt_list;
204: 
205: #ifdef AMP_RES_SERVER
206: 
207: 	u32  int_mask = amp_enter_critical();
208: 
209: 	ret_val = amp_res_acquire_cnt(res_id, SRC_CPU, &cnt_list);
210: 
211: 	amp_exit_critical(int_mask);
212: 
213: #else
214: 
215: 	ret_val = ipc_send_res_acquire_cnt(res_id, SRC_CPU, &cnt_list);
216: 
217: #endif
218: 
219: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
220: 	{
221: 		return ret_val;
222: 	}
223: 
224: 	if((cnt_list.self_req_cnt == 0) && (cnt_list.others_req_cnt == 0))
225: 	{
226: 		/* resource is free, so set semaphore state to available. */
227: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&amp_res_sync[res_id].res_sema);
228: 
229: 		amp_res_sync[res_id].owner_cpu = SELF_CPU;
230: 	}
231: 
232: 	ret_val = rtos_get_semaphore(&amp_res_sync[res_id].res_sema, timeout_ms);
233: 
234: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
235: 	{
236: 		/* timeout, someone holds the semaphore, so decrease the req_cnt before returns fail. */
237: 		bk_err_t ret_val2;
238: 		
239: 		ret_val2 = res_release_cnt(res_id, &cnt_list); /* decrease the req_cnt. */
240: 		
241: 		if(ret_val2 != BK_OK)
242: 			return ret_val;
243: 
244: 		if(cnt_list.self_req_cnt == 0)
245: 		{
246: 			rtos_get_semaphore(&amp_res_sync[res_id].res_sema, 0); /* clear semaphore. */
247: 			/*
248: 			 *  should clear semaphore here.
249: 			 *  in case that semaphore is set 
250: 			 *  between get_semaphore is timeout  and res_release_cnt decreases the self_cnt to 0.
251: 			 */
252: 			
253: 			/* 
254: 			 *  the side effect may accidently cause someone fail to acquire resource
255: 			 *  during res_release_cnt decreases the self_cnt to 0 and call get_semaphore to clear the semaphore.
256: 			 */
257: 
258: 			/* 
259: 			 * if not doing so, there may be the case that 2 tasks get permision to control the same resource.
260: 			 */
261: 		}
262: 	}
263: 
264: 	return ret_val;
265: 
266: }

268: bk_err_t amp_res_lock_release(u16 res_id, const char * func_name, int line_no)
269: {
270: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
271: 
272: 	if (!rtos_is_scheduler_started()) {
273: 		return BK_OK;
274: 	}
275: 
276: 	if( rtos_is_in_interrupt_context() )
277: 	{
278: 		BK_LOGE("AMP", "can't call in ISR %s,%d\r\n", func_name, line_no);
279: 
280: 		return BK_FAIL;
281: 	}
282: 
283: 	if(res_id >= AMP_RES_ID_MAX)
284: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
285: 
286: 	if(amp_res_sync[res_id].inited == 0)
287: 		return BK_ERR_NOT_INIT;
288: 
289: 	amp_res_req_cnt_t	cnt_list;
290: 
291: 	ret_val = res_release_cnt(res_id, &cnt_list);
292: 
293: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
294: 	{
295: 		return ret_val;
296: 	}
297: 
298: 	if(cnt_list.self_req_cnt > 0)
299: 	{
300: 		/* other task is waiting for the resource, so unblock the task. */
301: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&amp_res_sync[res_id].res_sema);
302: 	}
303: 	else if(cnt_list.others_req_cnt > 0)
304: 	{
305: 		/* other CPU is waiting for the resource, so inform CPU that it is available. */
306: 		/* which CPU is selected in multi-cores? (over than 2 cores)*/
307: 		ret_val = ipc_send_available_ind(res_id);
308: 	}
309: 
310: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
311: 	{
312: 		return ret_val;
313: 	}
314: 
315: 	return ret_val;
316: 
317: }

326: 	if(amp_res_sync[res_id].inited != 0)
327: 		return BK_OK;

329: #ifdef AMP_RES_SERVER

332:

335: 		amp_res_sync[res_id].req_cnt[i] = 0;
336: 	}

168: {

173:     if (!mailbox_queue_ptr) {

178:         return MAILBOX_INVAL_PARAMS;

181:     if (tfm_ns_mailbox_os_lock_acquire() != MAILBOX_SUCCESS) {

191:     mailbox_wait_reply(slot_idx);

194:     ret = mailbox_rx_client_reply(slot_idx, &reply_buf);
195:     if (ret == MAILBOX_SUCCESS) {

226:     for (idx = 0; idx < NUM_MAILBOX_QUEUE_SLOT; idx++) {
227:         /*

229:          * the wake-up signal is not sent yet.

289:     while (1) {

292:         /*
293:          * Woken up from sleep
294:          * Check the completed flag to make sure that the current thread is
295:          * woken up by reply event, rather than other events.
296:          */
297:         /*

299:          * in privileged mode.

301:          * But a spinlock-like mechanism is still required.

303:         is_replied = mailbox_wait_reply_signal(idx);
304:         if (is_replied) {

309:     return MAILBOX_SUCCESS;
